text:
Maria L.: Quick sync — uploaded a fresh harvest for the summarization promptset, but hit a cluster of near-duplicates and ~240 borderline examples. Link: https://redwood.internal/curation/harvests/2026-03-15
Kai T.: saw it. are the duplicates same-domain or fuzzy paraphrases?
Maria L.: mostly docs + support tickets — same semantics, slight rewording. exact-string dedupe misses these.
Sudhir P.: recommend semantic-hash dedupe + cosine threshold 0.88. also flag paraphrases as potential golden candidates if they expose different model behavior.
Alex J.: can we split the 240 into adjudication micro-batches? i can do batching script.
Maria L.: yes — 4 batches (60 each). plan: 3 reviewers per item, 1 adjudicator. timeline: end of week.
Kai T.: who are reviewers? i can take a batch.
Sudhir P.: propose reviewers = @kai, @alex, @divya; adjudicator = @maria.
Eva (label-bot): created tasks: tasks/curation/2026-03/batch-1 .. batch-4. labels due Fri 18:00 PT.
Alex J.: for the ambiguous "instruction-following" subset add a short rubric: prefer the response that directly answers the explicit ask even if shorter. include 2 positive + 2 negative examples.
Maria L.: added rubric + examples in task description; also tagged items with "answer-length" and "ambiguous-instruction".
Kai T.: small but important: many edge cases originate from quantized-run v1-quant4 in the eval logs — could be a regression from the new 4-bit kernel.
Sudhir P.: good catch. attach model metadata to each flagged item: model=v1-quant4, run=2026-03-15, seed=42. i'll run a quick diff vs fp16 baseline after labeling.
Maria L.: we also need to expand the golden set by ~50 vetted items covering multi-step reasoning and instruction ambiguity.
Alex J.: i'll curate 25 items from the failure log; need a second pass for vetting.
Kai T.: i'll take the other 25. after vetting we merge into golden CSV and bump the golden manifest.
Eva (label-bot): golden update PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/curation/pull/512 (includes schema, new examples, and metadata).
Maria L.: after labeling completes, schedule a mini-eval comparing fp16 baseline vs quant4 on the updated golden set (accuracy + instruction-fidelity metrics).
Sudhir P.: i'll run the eval and post a short summary table here.
Alex J.: adjudication rule: majority wins; if 3-way tie escalate to product for policy (we need a clear tie-break for answer-length tradeoffs).
Kai T.: ack — i'll ping product if ties > 3 across batches.
Maria L.: thanks everyone — i'll post the final batch manifest + adjudication sheet in ~1h. :white_check_mark:
Eva (label-bot): reminder in 48h :bell: — labels due.
